note: What a server sends about how its clock and a client's are being brought together. The header carries zero.

fields.name: clientTime
fields.note: The client's clock, in seconds, as the client reported it.

fields.name: roundTrip
fields.note: The round trip time the server measures, in seconds.

fields.name: convergence
fields.note: How long the two clocks take to agree, in seconds. It has no effect on a client.
